name: Janet Grimtaze
original_name: ジャネット・グリムターゼ
source:
She is the daughter of a large aristocrat and wealthy family. She is a critic of the empire and a domineering figure under the umbrella of her father's and the nation's authority.

She is always accompanied by three cronies who are always in a waistcoat. She hates people who are better than her and has a one-sided rivalry with the all-powerful Amelia. 

But after the confrontation between Iriya and Amelia, she begins to see Iriya, who can do everything to the best of her ability, as her rival as well.
